The question asks for the average annual income of specific clients, but the database does not contain any column or table that records individual clients' income or salary. turns.sql:
SELECT di.A3 AS region, AVG(di.A11) AS average_annual_income
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id AND ca.type = 'gold'
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date BETWEEN '1960-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'
GROUP BY di.A3
ORDER BY average_annual_income DESC;
